care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

## Child Benefit Eligibility Assessment Result

**I'm sorry, but you are not eligible for Child Benefit for Alex.**

### Why you're not eligible:

Alex is 16 years old. While children under 16 automatically qualify for Child Benefit, **children aged 16-19 only qualify if they are in approved education or training**, such as:
- A-levels
- Scottish Highers
- NVQs
- Other approved courses

Since Alex is not currently in approved education or training, they don't meet the qualifying child criteria.

### Important information:

**If Alex starts approved education or training**, you may become eligible for Child Benefit. Approved education means:
- Full-time non-advanced education (more than 12 hours per week of supervised study or course-related work experience)
- Courses must be at a school, college, or approved training provider

**Extension period**: If Alex had recently left education (within the last 20 weeks) and registered with the careers service or armed services, you might have qualified for an extension period, but this doesn't apply in your current situation.

### What happens if circumstances change:

If Alex enrolls in approved education or training in the future, you can make a new claim for Child Benefit at that time.

If you have any questions or if Alex's circumstances change, you can contact the Child Benefit Office for more information.
